name: Nativo
tagline: heditor's nativo: only the take, jump-cut zooms and Inter captions on a pill — no graphics, no music, no end card.

motion.direction: heditor `nativo`. Nothing but the take and its words: Inter 900 sentence-case captions on a pill, the spoken word black on `gold`; jump-cut zooms 1.0 ↔ 1.075 centred on the face at sentence starts (`zoom` mode); at most ONE `posterText` for the single biggest line, 2–3 words, fading in and out. No counters, no cards, no stamps, no SFX, no music, no end card beyond the handle. Hold the face.
